snippet.title: RuneQuest: Warlords | New Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
RuneQuest: Warlords is available now.
Built on the acclaimed engine behind Warhammer 40,000: Battlesector and enhanced with deeper melee combat systems, RuneQuest: Warlords delivers a rich strategic experience that blends classic turn-based tactics with the mythic power of Rune Magic.
Every encounter is shaped by terrain, positioning, line of sight, hero abilities, and divine forces drawn directly from the iconic RuneQuest universe.
By merging deep lore, impactful tactical combat, and the supernatural force of Rune Magic, RuneQuest: Warlords offers a strategy experience unlike any other, where every decision shapes the fate of tribes, empires, and the world itself.

To celebrate launch, the game is available now with a 10% launch discount on Steam for a limited time.
Let the battle begin.

🎮 Grab your copy now on Steam ➡️ https://nwzo.io/click/c26ea 
💬 Join the Discord Server ➡️  https://discord.gg/Xb5ap82qT4
